notes.title: [MANDATORY MEMO] Drill Core 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Platform Managers! [/p][p][/p][p]The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors is pleased to announce that [b]Drill Core is out now[/b]! 
Please consult the full changelog at the conclusion of this memo for an overview of all the changes, or simply update your game now to experience them firsthand. As always, Drill Core Inc. would like to remind all Platform Managers that the company is in no way liable for, or sympathetic to, resulting loss of life or damages. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Iaq3A2szEag;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Swarnids Join Drill Core Inc. [/b][/p][p]
To combat the extraneous food, sleep, and sanitation costs of both human and Dwarven workers, the Board of Directors sanctioned the creation of a temporary Minimally Demanding Bioform Search Committee, who were able to find ‘Swarnids’, a species that hatch from larvae, and importantly, are legally classified as non-sentient, to assist with all mining operations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/730a8c18d2260e55f785f1595c4e783a11bfdde0.gif"][/img][/p][p]Platform Managers will now be able to unlock the[b] Swarnid Platform[/b] from the main Upgrade console, which will allow you to utilize this new species. 
The starting buildings for the Swarnid Platform include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Swarnid Nest[/b]: Produces Larvae which can then be incubated to specific Worker types[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laboratory[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Laser Turret[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Swarnid Watchtower[/b]: Fires flies around itself every so often that latch onto targets and cause damage[/p][/*][/list][p]The Swarnid Platform also boasts an additional 20% damage to Night Enemies, owing to their superior experience of living in near-total darkness.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ab1fd38201cc8040f30dd6d34acdee6b33dcffe1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Three types of Workers will be available to select from the Swarnid Nest; upon selection, Larvae will fly to a random Block, where they’ll incubate for a short period of time before emerging as a fully operational Swarnid. [/p][p]Each of these Workers count as 0.5 of your Worker allocation, and these Worker types include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Swarnid Gnawlers[/b]: Dig earth with their teeth to extract resources[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swarnid Lumpers:[/b] Carry resources back to the platform[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swarnid Wardens:[/b] Defend the Swarm from attacks[/p][/*][/list][p]We look forward to the increased profits as you utilize this new species for your contracts, Platform Managers! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/99ff6846470caac925eb4f7e0e3dd412f7e5e1d4.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Turret Innovations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The R’n’D Department has been hard at work during their mandated overtime to provide various upgrades to Turret technology; all Platform Managers will have the option to select the [b]Improved Turret Assembly upgrade[/b] in the main upgrade console, which will permit the installation of upgrade modules on all Turrets. [/p][p]These upgrade modules will provide you with access to an individual upgrade tree for each Turret, and will vary based on the type of Turret, but may include a boost to shooting speed, attack radius, or even double damage chance! 
There are multiple levels to each of these upgrades, each offering an increase in percentage for their designated stat.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/220a2c947e95b5c79f4fbba14c265165c0c24553.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Platform Managers will also notice a new [b]Turret Focus Priority[/b] available for each turret. This new setting will allow you to select the priority for each individual turret’s defensive actions, and will allow you to target various attributes of alien species, including those closest or furthest from the turret, those with the lowest or highest health within range, and those closest or furthest from the core itself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/d49272f87e55de8bf9614cfbb2f98d00dff51beb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, you’ll notice that all turrets now show basic parameters [i]before[/i] building, allowing for more visibility on the impact each turret will have before spending those precious resources on building it. 
[/p][p]We look forward to seeing how you utilize these new innovations in turret management to optimize success on each contract, Platform Managers![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/2e182b09e7a7dfc1ba5cc2db79d438a5dbc3a622.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Management Optimizations and Quality of Life Changes[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Drill Core Inc., under the advisement of legal representatives, is introducing a range of new features designed to make Platform Management more streamlined. 
Firstly, Platform Managers will note that there are new[b] Resource Management[/b] options available during contracts; these will allow you to prioritize specific resources for your Workers to collect. Whether you’re looking to upgrade your turrets, or need a specific resource for an upgrade, you’ll be able to globally assign a resource to be prioritized - or de-prioritized - as needed, letting your Workers know where to best use their time. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/58cae3be1b8e79207c30ff1ee83770df567db310.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are now [b]10 new qualifications[/b] available to unlock during contracts for the most diligent of managers, which include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Blocker: [/b]Active daytime ability. Select an empty area where a foam Block will be created. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Swarnid Incubator Turret[/b]: Incubates Swarnubs during the day and releases them to fly around the Mine. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Solaris Lens: [/b]Active daytime ability. Select a Block zone at which lasers will shoot over a period of time, damaging both Enemies and Blocks. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/74ec42d16cde64889273a6f911128d1c219c05da.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Spot an unfamiliar Block or Enemy? Now managing those threats is easier than ever, as Platform Managers will have access to the [url="https://drillcore.wiki.gg/"][u]Drill Core Wiki[/u][/url] entries for all Blocks and Aliens they encounter during a contract; simply holding the ‘ctrl’ button and hovering over the Block or Alien will bring up the relevant Wiki entry, giving you a quick insight into any necessary changes in strategy. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/2a9df192d7046b8b03905a785cfcced8934988d2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ll now be able to see the impact your defenses are having on keeping Aliens at bay with the option to [b]Show Damage Numbers[/b] making its way into this update. Gain valuable insights into which turrets and abilities are making the most significant impacts, so you can best-optimize your strategy during your contracts. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/8ff8e379d6ae7cc740be7e4d028732eec86170cd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Platform Managers will now have the option to ban certain buildings from the Technology pool for the duration of a contract, allowing you to preserve your precious Technology Rerolls if there’s a Building you don’t feel will be useful for the particular contract you’re completing. [/p][p]However, be careful with this option, Platform Managers - once a Building has been banned, you won’t be able to use it for the duration of the contract! 
[/p][p]Of course, there are plenty of additional Quality of Life improvements incorporated into the update, including improved gamepad controls to make both adding orders and moving the camera easier, and new gameplay tips on the main menu. For the full list of all improvements, the complete Changelog is below. [/p][p]
As a sign of appreciation from the Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors to those who joined our workforce during Early Access, you’ll be able to download a small free DLC of cosmetic items, the [b]Shareholder Pack[/b], which showcases our gratitude, including a unique[b] Testing Unit Platform Skin[/b] for the Earthcrusher platform, and a badge showing the Platform Manager’s nickname and avatar on the main menu. 
We have also added a unique new [b]Cyberpunk Platform Skin [/b]as an additional bonus to our [b]Supporters Pack[/b], which will be available there for all previous and new owners forever.
We hope this effectively communicates the value we place on your early contributions to our profit margins.[/p][p] [/p][p]That brings us to the end of the topline overview of everything that’s included in the 1.0 Release; for those Platform Managers who are particularly diligent, you may review the full Changelog at the end of this post. 
[/p][p]As always, we strongly encourage all Platform Managers to follow the corporate [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40drillcoregame"][u]TikTok[/u][/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fdrillcoregame"][u]Twitter[/u][/url] accounts for a clear line of communication with Drill Core Inc., and also to take part in company-wide conversations on the corporate [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FN67zjtTjgw"][u]Discord server[/u][/url]. 
[/p][p]Rarely warm regards,
The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the Swarnid Platform, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]The unique Swarnid Watchtower building (available only to Swarnids).[/p][/*][*][p]A unique Swarnid larva mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]10 unique Swarnid Platform upgrades, including the upgrade that allows you to move turrets.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to change turret target focus.[/p][/*][*][p]Each turret now has between 3 and 15 upgrades, including unique ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets now display more detailed stats (including damage, rate of fire, firing range, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a global ore-priority setting for couriers.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an upgrade that lets you ban technologies so they won’t appear again until the end of the contract.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 10 new qualifications, which include new turrets and abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved gamepad controls: giving orders is now easier, and camera control has been enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-game wiki. notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMO] Management Overview Developments
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Platform Managers! [/p][p]
With the full launch of Drill Core on [b]July 17[/b] fast approaching, the Board of Directors has generously allowed the R’n’D Department a brief break from their mandatory uncompensated overtime to share some of the upcoming developments you can expect from the full 1.0 release. These improvements are expected to allow for streamlined management of all mining contracts, and we look forward to seeing the expected increase in output from all Platform Managers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/2e182b09e7a7dfc1ba5cc2db79d438a5dbc3a622.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Streamlined Resource Management [/b][/p][p]
Whether you’re needing to upgrade your Turrets to handle those Aliens at night, or trying to upgrade your Technology so you can unlock a much-needed building, there are various reasons you may need to prioritize specific resources for your Workers to collect; and now, you’ll be able to! [/p][p]
Using the new Resource Management menu that will appear during your contracts, you will be able to select to prioritize specific resources globally for all Workers, making them easier to manage during your contracts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/74ec42d16cde64889273a6f911128d1c219c05da.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]In-Game Wiki [/b][/p][p]
Platform Managers will now have access to the [u][url="https://drillcore.wiki.gg/"]Drill Core Wiki[/url][/u] entries for all Blocks and Aliens they encounter during a contract; simply holding down the Wiki button will allow you to access the specific entry for that Block or Alien type, allowing you to better-manage how your Miners and Guards respond to threats and challenges from unfamiliar sources. [/p][p]
We expect to see a significant increase in the profits of completed contracts due to the decreased loss of life in the wake of these changes! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/8ff8e379d6ae7cc740be7e4d028732eec86170cd.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Technology Management [/b][/p][p]
Strategic Platform Management is an integral part of any successful mining contract, and the R’n’D Department is introducing a new mechanic that will make this easier than ever before; Platform Managers will now have the option to ban certain buildings from the Technology pool for the duration of a contract. This means those Buildings will no longer be an option, and you’ll be able to preserve your precious Technology Rerolls if there’s a Building you don’t feel will be useful for the particular contract you’re completing. [/p][p]Use this new option wisely, Platform Managers - once a Building has been banned, you won’t be able to use it for the duration of the contract! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/58cae3be1b8e79207c30ff1ee83770df567db310.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Additional Management Improvements [/b][/p][p]
Of course, the developments mentioned above are far from the full scope of everything Platform Managers can expect from the full 1.0 release; among the new features you’ll be able to enjoy on July 17 are [b]10 new qualifications[/b], [b]Turret Parameters[/b] which show various parameters depending on the Turret type like damage and range of Turrets [i]before[/i] building, and the option to[b] View Damage Numbers[/b] for your defenses on Aliens. [/p][p]
We’ll look forward to sharing the full range of changes with you when 1.0 launches on July 17th. [/p][p]
As always, we strongly encourage all Platform Managers to follow the corporate [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40drillcoregame"]TikTok[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fdrillcoregame"]Twitter[/url][/u] accounts for a clear line of communication with Drill Core Inc., and also to take part in company-wide conversations on the corporate [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FN67zjtTjgw"]Discord server[/url][/u]. [/p][p]
Moderate regards,
The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMO] New Worker Species to Join Drill Core Inc.
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Platform Managers! [/p][p]
The HR Department is thrilled to share that a new species of workers will be joining Drill Core Inc. alongside the full launch on [b]July 17[/b]. As such, the Board of Directors has generously permitted them to share a brief overview of this new species of workers with you. [/p][p]Please allow us to introduce you to [b]Swarnids[/b]![/p][p]
Due to the extraneous food, sleep, and sanitation costs of both human and Dwarven workers, the Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors sanctioned the creation of a temporary Minimally Demanding Bioform Search Committee, who were able to find Species 637-B, hereby referred to solely as ‘Swarnids’; creatures that hatch from larvae, are lead by a Queen and importantly, are legally classified as non-sentient, to assist with all mining operations. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/75e91447bac6d2936dc878a2dd0de722adbb4b31.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]The Swarnid Platform [/b][/p][p]
Platform Managers will now be able to unlock the Swarnid Platform from the main Upgrade console, which will allow you to utilize this new species, and all associated buildings required to effectively manage the Swarnids. [/p][p]
Upon selecting the Swarnid Platform, your starting buildings will include: the [b]Swarnid Nest[/b], which will produce Larvae; a Swarnid-run [b]Laboratory[/b] for upgrades; a [b]Swarnid Incubator Turret[/b], which incubates Swarnubs during the day and releases them to fly around the Mine; the [b]Laser Turret[/b]; and a [b]Swarnid Watchtower[/b], which fires flies around itself every so often that latch onto targets and cause damage. 
Due to the Swarnids’ superior experience of living in near-total darkness, the Swarnid Platform also offers an additional 20% damage to Night Enemies. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ab1fd38201cc8040f30dd6d34acdee6b33dcffe1.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Swarnid Workers [/b][/p][p]
All Swarnid Workers are created from Larvae that hatch from the Swarnid Nest, and Platform Managers will designate which Worker type they need. Upon selection, Larvae will fly to a random Block, where they’ll incubate for a short period of time before emerging as a fully operational Swarnid. [/p][p]
There are three types of Swarnid Workers: [b]Swarnid Gnawlers [/b]can dig earth with their teeth; [b]Swarnid Lumpers[/b] can carry resources to their base; and [b]Swarnid Wardens[/b] defend the Swarm from attacks. Each of these basic workers count as 0.5 of your workforce, so Platform Managers can enjoy a full Swarm of Workers in no time. [/p][p]
We look forward to seeing your profits increase as you learn how to work with this fascinating species! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/2ee6bdf11adfa639ea62d1beeb32fa8fe9b87568.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Swarnid Upgrades[/b][/p][p]Of course, introducing a new species to Drill Core Inc.’s workforce has allowed the R’n’D Department to expand upon their operations, and they have prepared a range of upgrades for those Platform Managers who meet their performance - and profit! - targets. [/p][p]As such, various upgrades will be available for the Swarnid Platform from your Upgrade Console, some of which the R’n’D Department has shared with us below:[/p][list][*][p][b]Acceleration Spores:[/b] Swarnid Workers will leave behind a small cloud upon death, which will speed up surrounding Swarnids for a period of time. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Genetic Optimization: [/b]Certified Swarnid genetic optimization ensures that every 4th hired worker is born genetically enhanced. notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMO] Turret Innovations
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Platform Managers! 
[/p][p]The R’n’D Department is hard at work on the development of various upgrades and features to better optimize company performance ahead of Drill Core Inc.’s worldwide launch on [b]July 17[/b], but has been allocated this brief intermission to share some news of what you, our industrious employees, can expect in the coming weeks. 
Please utilize your gracious 10 minutes of allocated training and development time to familiarize yourself with these developments. [/p][p]
[b]Improved Turret Assembly [/b][/p][p]Due to new mandates on the R’n’D Department’s working hours, new innovations have been made in how turrets are installed for Platform Managers, with upgrade modules now available for each turret; to be able to access these developments, simply select the Improved Turret Assembly upgrade option from the main upgrade menu before starting a new contract. [/p][p]These new upgrade modules allow for more control over how turrets will behave during mining operations, allowing for heightened security for the on-site team. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/99ff6846470caac925eb4f7e0e3dd412f7e5e1d4.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Turret Upgrade Options[/b][/p][p]Upon selecting an installed turret during contracts, you’ll now have access to an individual upgrade tree for that turret, with various options to alter the original parameters on the base turret. These upgrades include [b]Shooting Speed[/b], which will increase the shooting speed of a turret by a certain percentage; [b]Attack Radius[/b], which will provide a percentage increase to the range on turrets; and [b]Double Damage Chance[/b], which offers a chance for double damage to occur when the turret fires. [/p][p]There are multiple levels to each of these upgrades, each offering an increase in percentage for their designated stat.[/p][p][i]Please note that each of these upgrades will require both Iron and Swarmlit to be successful; whilst Drill Core Inc. does not condone ‘needless’ death in the completion of contracts, we do implore you to consider the value of these resources to the company and consider each upgrade carefully. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/220a2c947e95b5c79f4fbba14c265165c0c24553.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Turret Focus Priority [/b][/p][p]The second change diligent Platform Managers will notice thanks to these developments is the new Turret Focus Priority available for each turret. This new setting will allow you to select the priority for each individual turret’s defensive actions, and will allow you to target various attributes of alien species, including those closest or furthest from the turret, those with the lowest or highest health within range, and those closest or furthest from the core itself. 
These new defensive options allow for greater control over defensive operations during contracts, and we do look forward to the increase in profits all Platform Managers will be expected to deliver due to this improvement to defenses. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ve found this insight into new developments insightful, and are planning accordingly. [/p][p]As always, we strongly encourage all Platform Managers to follow the corporate [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@drillcoregame"]TikTok[/url] and [url="https://x.com/drillcoregame"]Twitter[/url] accounts for a clear line of communication with Drill Core Inc., and also to take part in company-wide conversations on the corporate [url="https://discord.gg/N67zjtTjgw"]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: [MANDATORY MEMO] Oversight Depts Update Now Available 💼
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Platform Managers! [/b]

The Board of Directors is pleased to announce that the Oversight Depts Update for Drill Core is now live! 
You may also consult the full changelog at the conclusion of this memo, or update your game to experience the changes firsthand - just remember that Drill Core inc. holds no liability for disagreeable outcomes, including but not limited to loss of life, due to these new discoveries and technologies. 

[previewyoutube=urhOXPynPNE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Oversight Departments Join Drill Core Inc. [/b]

Due to the continued growth of the company, Drill Core Inc. has invested in new expansions within our corporate infrastructure, leading to the introduction of new Oversight Departments! 
You’ll now be able to select one department from the pre-operational mining screen to monitor your progress and reward you for your achievements. The selected department will gain experience equal to your Division Level, and for every level that department gains, you’ll be rewarded with Technologies or Resources.
Platform Managers will only be able to select one department at a time for these rewards, but there will be no penalty for changing your selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/6a90b4d20eaec430a56a92d01afbcc0716415637.jpg[/img]
These departments include:[list]
[*] Department of Unethical Innovations - Pioneering solutions nobody asked for, using technologies nobody approved. If it moves, it’s innovation; if it explodes, it's progress. And yes, we have very good lawyers.
[*] Department of Aggressive Negotiations - Why argue when you can intimidate? Our negotiation skills are measured in kilotons. If your conversation doesn't involve explosions, you're doing it wrong.
[*] Department of Accidental Safety - We didn't intend to make this place safe—it just kind of happened. Remember, safety isn't our goal; it's a delightful accident.
[*] Department of Overly Dramatic Solutions - Never solving problems quietly when they can be solved dramatically. If it doesn't involve explosions, laser beams, or loud speeches, we're not interested.
[*] Department of Chaotic Optimization - When something works too well, we're suspicious. Rest assured, we'll fix it until it's just complicated enough to confuse everyone equally.
[*] Department of Excessive Wealth - Managing more money than we could possibly need or explain. We're pretty sure it's all legal—well, legal enough. Just enjoy the bonuses and don't ask too many questions.[/list]We look forward to seeing how you implement these new departments and their unique upgrades, Platform Managers, and we hope you’ll take the time to thank the Drill Core Inc. HR Department for all their strenuous efforts in streamlining this restructuring process. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/1afeac4c8aebb7823613f2b777c78affa8580c60.png[/img]
[b]Mineshaft Expansions [/b]

As discussed in an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/525338740326926241]earlier company-wide memo[/url], discoveries by the R ‘n’ D Department in a new, thinner type of resolit have enabled them to make alterations to the landing sites of mining platforms, allowing a greater variance in the mine shafts you’ll be able to extract valuable resources from on each planet. Not only will you notice more variety in the shape of the mines themselves, but they’ll also be far wider and deeper than previous shafts.

All mineshafts will become up to 3-4 times wider, and will also be significantly deeper past 150m drilling depth; indestructible resolit now creates much more varied, unique pathways for your miners to navigate, too. 

The R ‘n’ D Department have also been hard at work in researching new drilling techniques and technologies, and progress in this area now means that all Platform Managers will now be able to drill deeper on planets, going well beyond the previous maximum of 1000m.

Overall, this should increase the amount of valuable resources you’re able to extract from each planet, and we look forward to seeing an impressive increase in profits from all contracts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/688751ac012f73ff7d4d7470c84a577697eff4f2.gif[/img]

[b]New Block Types [/b]

Several new types of blocks have been discovered in both the Cave and Frost Biomes; this includes [b]4 new Cave Biome blocks[/b] and [b]5 new Frost Biome blocks[/b]. 

Cave Biome Blocks:
[list][*] Eruption Block - Explodes in a specific direction upon destruction. The explosion deals damage to blocks and living creatures along its path up to the nearest block or within a 2-block radius. 
[*] Explosive Block - Explodes after a few seconds when HP falls below 10%. Deals damage to living creatures and blocks within a 1-block radius. 
[*] Geyser Block - Releases a powerful jet of steam and flies in one of four possible directions, killing everything in its path.
[*] Black Hole Block - Every so often will create a spacial rift in a block within a 2-block radius, and will after a short period of time pull whatever occupies that space (including your team members) into the black hole.[/list]Frost Biome Blocks:
[list][*] Windwhirl Block - Periodically pushes away other blocks in a 5-block radius in cardinal directions using wind. The pushed block kills everything in its path.
[*] Vacuum Block - Periodically activated block that pulls all ore within a 2-block radius towards itself using wind. 
[*] Cryostone Block - Regenerates over time at the location it was destroyed.
[*] Husker Twin Block - Drops half of a monster upon destruction. If another monster half exists on the level, they grow wings, fly toward each other, and merge into a large, dangerous monster.
[*] Echo Block - When struck, this block begins to resonate, transmitting the impact to adjacent blocks. Deals 80% of the received damage to blocks in cardinal directions.[/list]For more information and visual reconnaissance of these new Block types, please refer to the [url=https://drillcore.wiki.gg/wiki/Drill_Core_Wiki]official Drill Core Inc. Wiki[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/1179a2e0faaff738620d198a57152db0441012e2.png[/img]
[b]New Aliens [/b]

Recent developments have revealed [b]6 new species of enemies[/b] across the Cave, Jungle, and Frost Biomes; you’ll need to prepare accordingly to handle these new species, utilizing your buildings and turrets to ensure optimized performance and minimal loss of life during your contracts.
[list][*] Revigor - Upon death, leaves a cloud that heals nearby enemies.
[*] Slinger - Descends, like Arachnor, on a web. Periodically fires webbing at turrets within a radius. 
[*] Sentrix - Periodically generates a shield with a large radius around itself. Projectiles cannot pass through the shield.
[*] Healvok - Starts healing itself if it hasn't received damage for a set amount of time.
[*] Iceclaster - Explodes upon death, creating ice "blocks" in the air. These blocks block projectiles, have HP, and take damage similarly to enemies.
[*] Raptor - Increases the movement speed of nearby enemies. [/list]
Stay diligent out there, Platform Managers! We’re sure you’ll be able to handle the unique set of challenges each of these new aliens poses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/564b4a1984fa71b6927a3f48c098ff7becda9a22.gif[/img]

[b]New Buildings and Turrets[/b]

Naturally, with the discovery of new types of enemies on Drill Core Inc. planets, the R ‘n’ D Department has been hard at work creating new technologies and upgrades that will assist with the…management of alien lifeforms. These developments include [b]15 new buildings[/b] that offer an assortment of buffers, day- and, night-time abilities, as well as [b]6 new turret types[/b]. 
As these technologies are highly confidential and will be unlocked by developing relationships with the relevant Oversight Department, we’re unable to disclose them all, but they include:

New Buildings:
[list][*] Tesla Watchtower - Electrocutes enemies within range, stunning them. Each building operates independently.
[*] Nightshifters Post - Releases a certain number of Dwarf soldiers into the mine at night. Each building operates independently.
[*] Music Player - Active daytime ability. Select an area where workers receive a speed bonus. Each building increases the effect radius. More beats per minute means more rocks per minute![/list]New Turrets:
[list][*] Shrapnel Turret - Fires a projectile that explodes upon hitting an enemy, releasing projectiles in all directions. 
[*] Razor Turret - Shoots blades that pass through enemies. The blade does not disappear upon reaching the attack radius and can bounce off walls a maximum of three times. 
[*] Gasstorm Turret - Fires gas grenades that explode on impact, creating a gas cloud lasting for a certain number of seconds, and poisoning enemies.[/list]Please utilize these upgrades strategically, Platform Managers - they could make or break your contract, and therefore our profit margins. 

Of course, this is far from all that’s incorporated into the new update, and we welcome all employees to review the full changelog at the end of this post for additional details, or to upgrade your version of Drill Core to begin utilizing them immediately. 

For real-time corporate updates, follow Drill Core Inc. on [url=https://x.com/DrillCoreGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@drillcoregame]TikTok[/url], or join our corporate communications channel on [url=https://discord.com/invite/N67zjtTjgw]Discord[/url], where we can discuss together how to best build a better galaxy, one core at a time!

Best regards, 
Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors

notes.title: [MANDATORY MEMO] Drill Core Jungle Update is OUT NOW 🌴
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Platform Managers![/b]

We hope you’ve been finding our company-wide communications regarding the newly discovered Jungle Biome informative, because the time has finally arrived: the Drill Core Jungle Update is [b]out now[/b]! 
You may also consult the full changelog at the conclusion of this announcement, or update your game to experience the changes firsthand—no extra safety helmets required for the upgrade!

[previewyoutube=qtkIIKgMUag;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Jungle Biome Now Available[/b]

Contracts on Jungle Planets are now open for business, and will feature all-new terrain and various challenges which you, our exemplary employees, will need to adapt to in order to extract the best possible results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/df6d07c43124de190fbf98c93c6aa27c5ac8562a.gif[/img]

Naturally, as with all new planets, the Jungle Biome will be home to new Blocks for your workers to mine, or avoid, as needed; there are [b]11 new Unique Block types[/b] to discover on Jungle Planets, which you can read about in more detail in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/533215604137526404]previous post on the subject[/url]. 
These new Blocks include the [b]Slime Block[/b], which will fall down if it has no Blocks underneath it, trapping workers until the block is mined and they are released; the [b]Spore Block[/b], which periodically releases Spores that fly into the mine to create fresh blocks that need to be mined through, and the [b]Pull Block[/b], which pulls other blocks within a four-block radius towards it, killing everyone in its path. 
You’ll need to plan accordingly to prevent needless worker injury or death when it comes to these new Blocks, so please do consider this when managing your operations, Platform Managers. And, as a reminder, all resources acquired during mining operations remain company property.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/a30527d70aa30711d2807250e8f67902f2b28f94.gif[/img]

[b]New Unique Events [/b]

Jungle Planets will also be subject to their own Unique Events which may cause challenges during your excursions. The HR Department would like to remind all employees that any loss of life which occurs during contracts does not supersede your agreement with Drill Core Inc., and all resources acquired during mining operations are still considered property of the company. 

There are currently some negative planetary phenomena which may occur during your time on Jungle Planets, including: [b]Tropical Rainstorms[/b], which will temporarily increase block activity and [b]Increased Humidity[/b], which will make all blocks harder to excavate.
Positive planetary events will also be present; for example [b]Terrabors Migration[/b], where no Terrabors will harass mining operations at night, and [b]Southern Winds[/b], where winds will slow enemies down by 30% at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/bdef46063d2ca9a50dd21a089abb71d00f06e31b.gif[/img]

[b]New Enemies[/b]

As discussed in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/510698240578945056]previous memo[/url], you’ll encounter [b]9 new enemies[/b] on Jungle Planets, alongside [b]1 new Boss[/b] with its own unique subspecies. We’d like to take this opportunity to remind Platform Managers that no infractions will be levied against employees who are forced to react defensively against hostile creatures.

These new species include the [b]Sporling[/b], a slow creature which spawns tiny [b]Flesher[/b] enemies upon death; the [b]Parasite[/b], which sticks to other enemies, providing them with higher defence levels and attaches to a new enemy once its host is destroyed; and the [b]Fungalisk[/b], a large enemy with high damage, which spawns 10 small [b]Fleshers[/b] upon its death. 

Most enemies within the Jungle Biome do spawn small Flesher creatures when destroyed, which can quickly overwhelm your defences if not prepared for carefully; stay diligent, Platform Managers!

The [b]Sporelord[/b] has been classified as the apex predator of the Jungle Biome. All Sporelords spawn smaller subspecies of the same type upon death, rapidly escalating battlefield conditions. 
This particular Boss has various subspecies which may differ in appearance and abilities: the [b]Invisible Sporelord[/b] periodically becomes invisible, so that turrets cannot aim at it; the [b]Explosion Sporelord[/b] explodes after death, slowing down surrounding turrets; the [b]Sniper Sporelord[/b] is able to attack from a much greater range jeopardizing your Core and workers from further away; and the [b]Horde Sporelord[/b] creates more subspecies after death. 

Due to the various forms this Boss may take during your contracts, it’s advisable that all employees ensure they have the appropriate defences in place before engaging; we’d suggest extreme caution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/6770561b13b2465c2a163ca3476c31e63e882aad.png[/img]
[b]New Cores[/b]

The R ‘n’ D Department has been hard at work in creating [b]4 new Cores[/b] which may be utilized during contracts to best optimize output from your Platforms. Each new Core has its own unique properties, but before being able to implement them, Platform Managers will need to recover the necessary parts from various Planets. 
These Cores all have their own durability levels, as well as their own abilities which vary from the Core you’ll be used to utilizing during your contracts, as mentioned in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/579378315721179149]previous memo on the subject[/url]. 

The [b]Plasma Core[/b] will occasionally shoot out bolts of lightning at enemies, stunning them for 5 seconds, and once per contract will grant 5 swarmlit and 5 metal when it drops below 10% durability.

The [b]Titan Core[/b] is highly durable, but also grants 20% speed to all turrets when it reaches less than 20% remaining durability.  Once per contract, it will also gain the ability to be completely invincible for 15 seconds when it reaches less than 10% durability. 

The [b]Ion Core[/b] has 5 shields which help to prevent damage to it, and which will also recharge every morning; if all shields run out of charge, the Core will then stun all enemies for 5 seconds as a final line of defence. 

The [b]Phoenix Core[/b]  grants a reduction in the cost of drilling by 1 coal, and once per contract, upon reaching 0% remaining durability, this Core will explode, damaging all night monsters. It will then recover 50% of its maximum durability. 

These new core types will be an important part of your strategy on all contracts going forward, so it is recommended that you strive to unlock them and utilize them as necessary. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ba5e49b0bc3fd5d757cc39fd56a1ceba8bd0d3fa.png[/img]
[b]New Technology Quality System[/b]

There are now three rarity types of quality for each building, turret, and ability that you have the opportunity to unlock, which are marked by stars on the technology choice screen; this is called the [b]Technology Quality System[/b], and will be integral in assisting your mining operations. This new measure may impact the cost, efficiency, recharge time, and damage of the acquired technology, so you’ll want to balance the choices carefully to best optimize your Platform. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/8ed253c6b6396f6c3f7c0bc12ca0cbe345696e1e.gif[/img]

[b]Quality of Life and Balancing Updates[/b]

Naturally, at Drill Core Inc., we strive to best empower our employees to perform at their best during all contracts; therefore, upon updating, you’ll notice a range of additional features and Quality of Life changes that will allow you to optimize your operations. 

[b]Detailed Statistics[/b] are now available to view at the end of all contracts, allowing you an in-depth assessment of your performance during your mining operations. These statistics will include a range of empirical data, from how many workers have been lost during the contract, to how many turrets were built, and how many enemies have been killed. 

You’ll also notice some changes to [b]balancing[/b] when undertaking your contracts; difficulties 5-10 are now more difficult to complete, granting an additional challenge to your role as Platform Manager. The amount of [b]experience[/b] required to level up has also been reduced, and the experience calculation system has been slightly tweaked to better reflect this. There has also been an increase in the number of [b]permanent resources granted[/b] for completing contracts, of an additional 30%. 

You’ll also notice some changes to how [b]Turrets[/b] work and perform, including some increases to reload time, and differences in the duration of certain effects, which you can read about in full detail in the full changelog, below. 

We look forward to hearing your valued feedback as you venture into the Jungle Biome, and to seeing your increased output when utilizing the new technologies and statistics available to you, Platform Managers! 

For real-time corporate updates, follow Drill Core Inc. on [url=https://x.com/DrillCoreGame]Twitter[/url] or join our corportate communications channel on [url=https://discord.com/invite/N67zjtTjgw]Discord[/url].

Please also note that the official [url=https://drillcore.wiki.gg/wiki/Drill_Core_Wiki]Drill Core Wiki page[/url] has invaluable information regarding new enemies and block types found in the Jungle Biome, although we also appreciate any additional employee contributions. 

Best regards, 
Drill Core Inc. R'n'D department

notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMO] TECHNOLOGICAL DEVELOPMENTS FOR THE JUNGLE BIOME
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Platform Managers![/b]

We trust you’ve been preparing for your upcoming expeditions to the Jungle Biome, and have read our previous communications regarding both the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/533215604137526404]rich terrain you’ll be facing on Jungle Planets[/url], as well as the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/510698240578945056]new species you’ll be likely to encounter there[/url]. We remind you that keeping abreast of company communications is [b]mandatory[/b] for all Platform Managers, and Drill Core Inc. will not be held liable for any [i]errors in judgement[/i] when it comes to managing your workers or defences. 

The R ‘n’ D Department has been hard at work developing several new technologies which may assist with your upcoming excursions, some of which you will find disclosed below. As with all internal communications, we remind you that these developments are confidential. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/6770561b13b2465c2a163ca3476c31e63e882aad.png[/img]
[b]New Cores[/b]

When beginning your contract, you’ll now find [b]4 new Core Types[/b] are available to choose from within your Platform Presets; these new Cores all offer differing health and additional abilities. The [b]Phoenix Core[/b] will be upgradable through the Upgrades menu, whereas all other Cores will require you to find the necessary parts before being able to unlock the Core. 
These parts will begin spawning from 150m depth, and you may need to dig up to 600m to salvage them, so stay diligent! 

The [b]Plasma Core[/b] is not as durable as the original Core you’re used to, but [i]does[/i] possess the ability to occasionally shoot lightning bolts at enemies, stunning them for 5 seconds. Once per contract, this Core will also grant 5 swarmlit and 5 metal when it drops below 10% durability. 

The [b]Titan Core[/b], as its name may suggest, is a highly durable Core - however, upon reaching less than 20% remaining durability, it grants 20% speed to all turrets, allowing you to shore up your defences. Once per contract, it will also gain the ability to be completely invincible for 15 seconds when it reaches less than 10% durability. 

Although the [b]Ion Core[/b] is not as durable as the original Core, it does boast 5 shields, which help to prevent damage being dealt to it; each shield is granted a fresh recharge every morning, which should help you to keep this Core function at its best. If all shields run out of charge, the Core will then stun all enemies for 5 seconds as a final line of defence. 

Finally, the [b]Phoenix Core[/b] is the least durable of all your available Cores, but will grant a reduction in the cost of drilling by 1 coal. As its name may suggest, once per contract, upon reaching 0% remaining durability, this Core will explode, damaging all night monsters. It will then recover 50% of its maximum durability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ba5e49b0bc3fd5d757cc39fd56a1ceba8bd0d3fa.png[/img]
[b]Technology Quality System[/b]

You’ll now notice a new system in place when you earn technology during your mining operations: the [b]Technology Quality System[/b]. There are now three rarity types of quality for each building, turret, and ability that you have the opportunity to unlock, which are marked by stars on the technology choice screen. This new measure may improve the cost, efficiency, recharge time, range, and damage of the acquired technology, so you’ll want to balance the choices carefully to best optimize your Platform. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/00b34b9e19c3f0e846546963ea28497837036e74.png[/img]
There are also now a range of [b]permanent upgrades[/b] which can be unlocked to increase the likelihood of receiving rarer technologies, as well as unlocking new types of quality for these upgrades. 

[b]Detailed Statistics for Contracts[/b]

Upon completion of your contracts, you’ll now be granted the opportunity to view Detailed Statistics for the contract itself; this will allow you access to valuable data which will allow you to better optimize your output as a Platform Manager. 
These statistics will offer a range of empirical data, from how many workers have been lost during the contract, to how many turrets were built, and how many enemies have been killed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/8ed253c6b6396f6c3f7c0bc12ca0cbe345696e1e.gif[/img]

We trust you will use this data, alongside the new technologies the R ‘n’ D Department have provided, to improve your on-planet performance as you explore this new Biome. We look forward to your continued success. 

For real-time corporate updates, follow Drill Core Inc. on [url=https://x.com/DrillCoreGame]Twitter[/url] or join our corportate communications channel on [url=https://discord.com/invite/N67zjtTjgw]Discord[/url].

Please also note that the official [url=https://drillcore.wiki.gg/wiki/Drill_Core_Wiki]Drill Core Wiki page[/url] has invaluable information regarding new enemies and block types found in the Jungle Biome, although we also appreciate any additional employee contributions. 

Best regards and good luck,
The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors

notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMO] JUNGLE BIOME BIODIVERSITY INITIATIVE
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Platform Managers![/b]

We hope you have been able to keep up to date with our recent communications surrounding the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/533215604137526121]newly discovered Jungle Biome[/url], as well as our further internal memo regarding the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2821800/view/533215604137526404]harsh terrain and weather conditions[/url] which have been uncovered by our research team studying these new planets. Of course, reading communications from Drill Core Inc. is mandatory, so we’re sure you have endeavored to stay up-to-date with these developments.

As with all new [strike]properties[/strike] planets, the Jungle Biome does of course boast its own diverse range of creatures, some of which have regrettably failed to respect our mining contracts. Please make note of the following information to allow you to best oversee your operations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/4a114fdbce50459f8d7260f93a819bdd742820f0.gif[/img]

[b]New Enemies [/b]

Our research team has identified 9 new species of bugs which may attack your workers in the Jungle Biome; whilst they were unable to isolate all of the relevant species, they were able to disclose some useful information about some of these new enemies. 

The first new species you’ll likely encounter on Jungle Planets is the [b]Flesher[/b]; these tiny enemies aren’t particularly [i]durable[/i], but they are fast and can overwhelm your defences in vast numbers. 
Another creature you’ll want to look out for is the [b]Stealer[/b], identifiable by their long legs, which they may utilize to steal workers from your Platform if given the opportunity, lifting them skyward, and letting gravity handle the rest. 
You’ll also want to consider how some of these new enemies may impact your defenses: [b]Rootbinders[/b] will release vines on to surrounding turrets, slowing them down; [b]Ghosters[/b] will become invisible periodically, meaning turrets will not be able to target them.

[i]Please note that many of these new species do spawn Fleshers upon their demise; whilst they do not typically appear to have high HP, these creatures are fast, and in high numbers may pose a threat to the Core’s integrity, so it is important to have your defences optimized. 
Any damage to a Platform Manager’s Core will be liable for further action from Drill Core Inc.. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/bdef46063d2ca9a50dd21a089abb71d00f06e31b.gif[/img]

[b]New Boss [/b]

The [b]Sporelord[/b] has been classified as the apex predator of the Jungle Biome. All Sporelords spawn smaller subspecies of the same type upon death, rapidly escalating battlefield conditions.

Researchers tell us this particular Boss has various subspecies of differing appearances and abilities; the [b]Invisible Sporelord[/b] periodically becomes invisible, so that turrets cannot aim at it; the [b]Explosion Sporelord[/b] explodes after death, slowing down surrounding turrets; the [b]Sniper Sporelord[/b] is able to attack from a much greater range jeopardizing your Core and workers from further away; and the [b]Horde Sporelord[/b] creates more subspecies after death. 
Due to the unpredictable nature of Sporelord encounters, Platform Managers should exercise extreme caution and ensure that all defensive measures are optimized before engaging.

Despite the inconvenience of hostile wildlife, the Jungle Biome presents unparalleled opportunities for resource acquisition. With appropriate risk mitigation strategies, these obstacles can be converted into manageable operational challenges. We look forward to seeing the results of your expeditions when the Jungle Planets become available next week. Ensure all equipment is optimized, and be ready to report findings to company leadership upon deployment.

For real-time corporate updates, follow Drill Core Inc. on [url=https://x.com/DrillCoreGame]Twitter[/url] or join our corportate communications channel on [url=https://discord.com/invite/N67zjtTjgw]Discord[/url].

Best regards and good luck,
The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors

notes.title: The Dwarves, Beards and TNT Update is NOW LIVE 🚨
notes.content:

The HR Department is pleased to share that Drill Core Inc. has now entered into a strategic partnership with the Dwarves of planet Explosia. This partnership has allowed us to incorporate a whole new platform type, which can be unlocked with a new permanent upgrade, and will introduce the Dwarves into your workforce. 

Of course, Dwarves will behave slightly differently to your existing workers; bomber miners spawned in through the Dwarf Platform will utilize TNT to obliterate target mining zones, and Dwarven Guards will operate at night using heavy-duty jetpacks to rise from the mines and defend the platform. 

Aside from the differences in your workforce, you’ll also notice that the new Dwarf Platform will bring with it two new buildings to help you manage your employees, as well as some unique upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/8cd4669f9ff21a3455c0051c28b0f309a79d4d0e.gif[/img]

You’ll want to optimize these bonuses to make the most of them each time you start a contract - this is Platform [i]Management[/i], after all! 

[b]New Technology Type[/b]

You’ll notice a new technology type that is now available to unlock whilst undertaking your contracts: Boost Technology. This new type will offer you 30 unique bonus technologies to discover as you drill. 

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]

Of course, we had to include some quality of life features in this update; you’ll notice improved pathfinding AI for your workers, controller support (this is still in beta), new achievements for you to unlock, and lots of bugfixes to make for the most streamlined experience possible. 

This is far from everything that’s included in the update, so head to the full changelog below if you’d like to find out more, or simply update Drill Core in your Steam Library to try them out for yourself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/45b36e9f313045126130c342b361c0eb7d8a8657.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [TOP SECRET] NEW RACE OF WORKERS TO BE EMPLOYED
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Platform Managers![/b]

The Board of Directors is thrilled to announce that, since going public, [b]Drill Core Inc.[/b] has officially crossed the [i]500,000 contract milestone[/i] in terraforming operations across the galaxy! This achievement is a testament to the diligence and commitment of each and every one of you, our industrious employees, and it brings us one step closer to our vision of a fully monetized galaxy.

However, despite our success, we still see [i]room for improvement[/i] in contract completion rates. With the influx of resources you've secured through relentless terraforming, we’ve acquired a [i]strategic partnership[/i] with none other than the [b]Dwarves of planet Explosia[/b]. The HR department assures us that hiring them was as easy as throwing a gem into a mine—they simply can’t resist digging for precious minerals. (Of course, a minor policy adjustment was required: they will be permitted to consume... [i]refreshments[/i] during shifts. Your understanding is appreciated).

The rugged physiques and... explosive tendencies of these new recruits inspired R&D to design a [b]brand-new Platform[/b] tailored to their [i]unique needs[/i]. For your convenience, we’ve included a brief overview of their protocols below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ee42e6e01df855e518e28a32bb600587d27bfab5.png[/img]
[b]New Mining Technique[/b]

The Dwarves, with their [i]boundless strength and notable impatience[/i], have rejected traditional drills. Instead, they bring a more [i]direct approach[/i] to mining by donning explosion-absorbing suits and deploying a steady supply of TNT. Need a specific area mined? Simply send in a Dwarf, who—embracing their role as a [i]living bomb[/i]—will use TNT to obliterate any target zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/ceafa9a80827ab00c4bd44186106c3cbe27525a7.gif[/img]

Despite the obvious effectiveness of this approach, the downsides are also clear - you’ll dig everything around the explosion area, sometimes bringing unwanted attention. Moreover, in their stubborn commitment to traditions, dwarves refuse using anything more advanced than TNT. Therefore some blocks might require several detonations to gather resources.

[b]New Guarding Operations[/b]

Clad in more metal than most industrial containers, Dwarven guards are practically mistaken for boulders by most nighttime creatures (though some colleagues claim this has more to do with their blood-alcohol content). These guards are active at night, using heavy-duty jetpacks to rise from the mines and defend the platform with unmatched zeal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/a4e406cf2cccb88205589e219f86c7d3ba07cef3.gif[/img]

[b]New buildings[/b]

Instead of regular barracks, dwarves are using more sturdy ones with lower ceilings. But the functionality stays the same. What sets them apart is that they despise regular human factories, and instead will use free space to create Magma Refineries. Those buildings is a manifestation of how… hungry for minerals the dwarves are, since those facilities will process all rocks from blocks destroyed by dwarven bombs in attempt to extract just a little bit of resources from stones other races would deem as useless waste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029032/11111cd8e26d597ad48178ea14225a4e77993ca5.png[/img]
That concludes R&D’s memo for now. Rest assured, more updates are planned for next month, with [i]exciting innovations[/i] on the way.

We expect all formalities to be finished by December, so by that time you can expect your new employees and platforms to arrive by that month. Do not forget to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/N67zjtTjgw]corporate Discord[/url] so you don’t miss the opportunity to sign up for participation in early platform tests!

With this addition, we’ll continue shaping the galaxy one core at a time, while maintaining a [i]profitable balance[/i] of supply and demand. After all, we wouldn’t want our rates to fall due to an overabundance of services, now would we? 😉

With a bright vision for Drill Core Inc.’s future,
[b]The Drill Core Inc. Board of Directors[/b]

[h3][b]Welcome to Drill Core![/b][/h3]

So, you're the new recruit, huh? Alright, let me brief you before you start the playtest.

At Drill Core, you'll be leading your team on some pretty dangerous missions to drill to the core of planets. Your main tasks? Well, you’ll be managing workers, extracting minerals, researching advanced technologies, and fending off those pesky nightly alien attacks. 

As you dig deeper, you’ll have to make some tough decisions. You'll need to carefully allocate your resources, balancing the urgency of mining with the need to protect your team. Remember, every choice you make will impact the success of your mission and the fate of the planet. No big deal, right? 

So, what's it gonna be? Will you push for maximum efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or will you focus on building up defenses to make sure everyone survives the night? 

[h3]Job duties include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Manage a team of [i]miners[/i], [i]carriers [/i]and [i]guards[/i].
[*] Place and upgrade turrets to fend off nightly alien attacks.
[*] Mine valuable minerals during each run.
[*] Balance upgrades between equipment, defenses, and drilling.
[*] Collect [i]Green Ore[/i] to unlock new tech, buildings, and abilities.
[*] Be ready to adapt! Each mission is different with random restrictions and technologies you’ll have at your disposal.
[/list]
Ready to give it a shot? [b]We've got a limited-time playtest now![/b]
Apply on our Steam page and see if you’ve got what it takes to get the job done and keep your crew safe. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821800/Drill_Core/
